snippet: ECOACERO, an ESTRELLA Group company, has placed an order with SMS group for a new rebar mill. It will be located nearby Santo Domingo, in Dominican Republic, for serving the growing local and regional construction industry. As one of the largest construction services and products group in the country, ESTRELLA made a strategic movement to reinforce its vertical integration, as well as the ecosystem formed by its companies. This ESTRELLA investment in a new rebar mill and meltshop aligns with ECOACERO's strategy to strengthen its market position in Central America's growing real estate and construction industry, where rebar is a fundamental building material.
